decisions.reason: The black-finish range sits close to the firm's established drainage know-how and has moved up to its own page, so the firm can read and act on its results and keeps building on it.
The shower channel for seamless coverings extends core channel technology the firm's own R&D understands well, and it has kept a dedicated page across both years, which signals continued commitment.

The pump-drain channel builds on the firm's drainage knowledge and appears to succeed the withdrawn pump-assisted product C, showing the firm learned from early results and should keep refining it despite the somewhat higher technical risk.
